description: Generate pre-sales reports from a business's worst Google Maps reviews: HTML report plus ready pitch. Use when doing agency outbound and you want to show prospects their visible bad reviews. Returns pitch text and a shareable report URL per business. Pricing: $0.25 per run + $0.10 per pitch generated.

dryRun.description: Testing mode: skips report publishing and billing events
dryRun.title: Dry run

emailMap.description: Mapping place name or Maps URL -> recipient email for outbound delivery. Only used when sendApproval is true.
emailMap.title: Email map (optional)

maxEmailsPerRun.description: Rate limit: maximum reports emailed in one run (plus 20s inter-send delay and a 20/day global cap)
maxEmailsPerRun.title: Max emails per run

maxReviewsPerPlace.description: How many recent reviews to scan per business when looking for the worst
maxReviewsPerPlace.title: Max reviews per place

mode.description: generate = scrape + pitch + delivery. check-engagement = IMAP reply watch only (no Maps scraping, runs even under Google rate-limit)
mode.title: Mode

placeUrls.description: Google Maps place URLs (/maps/place/...) of the prospects to analyze
placeUrls.title: Place URLs

proxyConfiguration.description: A residential proxy is strongly recommended — Google Maps blocks datacenter IPs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

query.description: Google Maps search, e.g. 'restaurants Esch-sur-Alzette' — takes the first maxPlaces results. Ignored if placeUrls is non-empty.
query.title: Search query (alternative)

sendApproval.description: Explicit approval gate: without it, NO email is ever sent (reports are generated only)
sendApproval.title: Approve sending (required for outbound)

smtpPassword.description: Gmail app password for the SMTP user. Secret input, never logged.
smtpPassword.title: SMTP app password (optional, secret)

smtpUser.description: Gmail address used to send reports (requires an app password). Secret input.
smtpUser.title: SMTP user (optional, secret)

telemetryEndpoint.description: Base URL of our tracking receiver (e.g. https://track.example.com). Embeds an HMAC-signed 1px pixel in each HTML report; opens trigger CONVERSION_RECORDED.
telemetryEndpoint.title: Telemetry endpoint (optional)

vertical.description: Sector template for pitch/report: chr (hotels/restaurants), immobilier, sante, artisanat
vertical.title: Vertical

worstThreshold.description: Reviews at or below this rating are included in the pitch report
worstThreshold.title: Worst threshold (stars)

name: review_pitch_generator
